newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Mylan estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Mylan estimates raised.

text.p: Dillon, Read said analyst Jerry Treppel raised earnings per share estimates on Mylan Laboratories Inc.
-- said recently spoke to Mylan management on generic version of Glaxo Wellcome Plc's anti-ulcer drug Zantac.
-- said in a report that when asked if Mylan's share of Novopharm Biotech Inc's generic Zantac revenues were about 10 percent, "the response was that we were a little low."
-- said "clearly, the generic Zantac arrangement is going to have a greater impact on earnings than we or others have suspected."
-- raised earnings estimate on Mylan's September quarter to $0.24 a share from $0.17 and fiscal 1998 estimate to $0.90 from $0.75. The company's fiscal year ends March 31.
-- said fiscal 1999 estimate of $1.01 was "clearly low" and that sees it coming in around $1.20 a share.
